## Overview

The Thormvuld family is a dwarven arcane engineering dynasty established in a one-shot before the campaign. They are the most prominent and proficient magical item producers on the continent, originating from the northeast settlement cluster.

## Structure

The family is organized around its master crafters and enchanters, with knowledge and technique passed down through generations. The family operates several workshops and foundries dedicated to the creation of magical equipment.

## Membership

The Thormvulds are a bloodline  -  membership is primarily by birth, though exceptional apprentices have been adopted into the family over the generations. Key members include:

- **Family Elders**: The oldest and most skilled members who oversee major projects
- **Master Enchanters**: Those who have mastered the art of magical item creation
- **Artificers**: Engineers who design and build magical devices
- **Apprentices**: Learners studying under the family's masters

## Goals

- Maintain their position as the premier magical item producers on the continent
- Advance the arts of enchanting and arcane engineering
- Preserve and expand their knowledge of magical craft
- Supply the Last Stand military with high-quality enchanted equipment

## Headquarters

The Thormvulds originate from the **northeast settlement cluster** and own a dedicated small settlement south of it, housing their primary workshops and foundries. They also maintain a significant presence in **Emberforge**.
